description: A scanning head for the video modules: it walks a position over a square grid and puts the coordinates out as voltages

params.text: Picks the path: Scanning runs left to right and top to bottom, Boustrophedon alternates the direction of each line, Spiral works out from the centre, and Random jumps to a new point
Sets how far the head moves each sample; in the random setting it is instead the chance of jumping to a new point
Sets how many lines the grid is divided into, 1 to 1000; set it to match the resolution of the VideoOut it feeds
Sets what voltage range the position outputs cover: -5V to +5V in one position, 0V to 10V in the other

outputs.text: Channel 1 carries the horizontal position and channel 2 the vertical
The horizontal position of the scanning head
The vertical position of the scanning head

notes: the head moves one step per audio sample, so at a speed of 1 and a resolution of 150 the grid is covered in 22500 samples
a signal fed through a VideoOut and an ImageIn arrives a frame late; the PreciseDelay module exists to line the two up again
